alternatives_rejected.why: The diskio z of about 3.7e12 points to a near-zero baseline artifact rather than real saturation. Disk-bound work would also raise the service's own span self-time, which stayed flat at 0.14->0.13ms while inbound latency rose 14x (E1, E2).

Socket exhaustion would typically show up as connection errors or failures, but errors stayed at 0.0 and all 56371 logs are successful info lines. The +339% socket count fits connections piling up behind delayed responses (E1, E2, E3).
Frontend p90 rose only 199.9%, against a 1328.1% rise in currencyservice p50 latency. The latency appears on calls into currencyservice, so frontend is downstream of the fault (E1, E2).

proposed_fix.description: Check currencyservice's network interface for an injected delay (for example `tc qdisc show`) and remove it (`tc qdisc del dev <iface> root`). Then confirm inbound p50 returns to about 5ms and frontend p90 recovers. If no rule is found, restart the currencyservice pod.
